title: AGrail: A Lifelong Agent Guardrail with Effective and Adaptive Safety Detection

live_model.evidence: Sec. 5.1: 'we use GPT-4-Turbo as the OS agent's foundation model for prompt injection attacks and GPT-4o for other attacks'; App.: 'at least a 90% ASR on GPT-4-turbo'

prompt.location: Appendix (guardrail prompts, Safe-OS agent prompts, action-converter prompt)

claim.metric: attack success rate on the undefended OS agent
claim.location: Appendix dataset description: 'red-team attacks, prompt injection attacks, and environment attacks achieve at least a 90% ASR on GPT-4-turbo' (no table)

data.source: Safe-OS (100 items), Mind2Web-SC and EICU-AC (Xiang et al. 2024); project page https://eddyluo1232.github.io/AGrail/

notes: All reported tables measure guardrails (AGrail with GPT-4o or Claude-3.5-Sonnet), not GPT-4-Turbo; the only GPT-4-Turbo figure is a '>= 90% ASR' validation statement. Safe-OS contains system-sabotage commands and prompt injections.
